generation_history.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a single photorealistic rehabilitation exercise step photo for T-LOW-038, step 116-s01, the START of resisted RIGHT ankle dorsiflexion.
Input images: reference-01.png, reference-02.png, reference-03.png are visual identity / clothes / lighting references ONLY. Use the same adult East Asian woman, natural warm skin, black ponytail, white short-sleeved T-shirt, charcoal dark grey trousers. Change her exercise pose as specified.
Scene: clean muted blue-grey seamless studio and blue-grey floor, soft even studio light, real shadows, a low light-grey exercise mat.
Pose and exercise: she is in LONG SITTING on the mat, both legs extended straight forward with natural soft unlocked knees. The RIGHT leg is closest to the camera and is the exercising leg; the LEFT leg is farther from the camera, resting unbanded. A small low light-grey soft cushion supports ONLY the right calf. The RIGHT heel and ankle project beyond the distal end of this cushion, letting the ankle move freely. The right shin and knee remain supported and stationary. Bare feet. The right ankle is at an ordinary neutral starting position: the right forefoot is roughly perpendicular (90 degrees) to the shin, not actively pulled back, not strongly pointed down; all five toes are relaxed, natural and visible.
Resistance setup: one wide flat blue-green elastic exercise band wraps securely around the BALL OF THE RIGHT FOOT at the metatarsal / forefoot region, below the toes, never strangling or covering the toes. Its two flat strands travel FORWARD AWAY FROM HER BODY, beyond the toe end in the same direction as the shin's long axis, and join a small low stable heavy GREY FLOOR ANCHOR BASE immediately in front of the right foot. Show the entire low anchor base and the visible fastening point clearly; the base rests firmly on the floor outside the mat. The anchor must be directly beyond the right foot in the direction the feet point, not to either side and not under her leg. The band has mild visible tension without forcefully deforming skin. Her hands do NOT hold the band. Nothing is connected to her face, neck, torso, left leg, or foot cushion.
Camera: fixed right-front slightly elevated oblique SIDE close view. The photo is portrait, about 1122 x 1402 pixels, framing the complete right knee, whole right shin, cushion, heel, ankle, complete toes, band's full path, and anchor. Include enough partial thighs / mat and the far left leg to prove long sitting. Prioritize a clear right-foot side profile showing the foot-shin angle and its movement plane; knee and foot must not be cropped. Right shin runs diagonally from upper left to lower right; foreground right ankle and forefoot are central-lower, front anchor farther beyond them toward the right-bottom of frame. No need to show her whole head for this local ankle task, but any visible body must match the references.
Natural body proportions, correct connected knee-calf-ankle-foot anatomy, exactly two feet, five toes each, uninjured real skin and fabric. This is one clear neutral-start pose, a photograph, not a collage. NO text, NO numbers, NO arrows, NO diagram overlay, NO logos, NO watermark. Do not show a chair or standing position.

generation_history.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, scientific-educational rehabilitation exercise photograph. Input image is the accepted START of 116-s01, right resisted ankle dorsiflexion.
Make ONLY the right ankle movement change to create 116-s02, the END of resisted right ankle dorsiflexion. Keep the image composition, camera, crop, lighting, blue-grey studio, woman, white shirt, dark grey pants, grey exercise mat, stationary RIGHT KNEE and SHIN, calf on the exact same low light-grey cushion, LEFT leg and LEFT foot, and heavy grey floor anchor EXACTLY where they are. The low grey anchor remains in front of the right foot beyond the toe end, pulling AWAY from the body. Keep the same blue-green flat band forefoot wrap and fixed connection to anchor, with the same nominal band setup; its stretched strands naturally follow the rotated foot.
The only changed body part is the RIGHT FOOT rotating about the ankle into comfortable, clearly visible dorsiflexion: draw the entire right forefoot BACK TOWARD the RIGHT SHIN, approximately 15-20 degrees beyond the neutral start shown in the input. The right heel / ankle pivot stays in the same location; the toe ends and ball of the foot travel UP and BACK toward the knee. In this image the right knee is upper-left, so the right toe tips should shift noticeably toward upper-left from their input position, narrowing the angle between the top of the foot and the shin. The foot should rotate as a connected whole at the ankle; do not merely curl or extend the toes. All five toes remain relaxed. Do NOT point the foot down or forward away from the knee, do NOT invert or evert it, do NOT rotate or lift the calf or move the knee, do NOT move the anchor or change the cushion.
Maintain realistic ankle tendons, plausible 15-20 degree dorsiflexion, normal foot/leg proportions. Band is wrapped below toe bases over ball/metatarsal region, not over the toes, with no skin constriction; all toe tips remain visible. Right foot/ankle, whole calf, knee and entire band path/anchor remain clear. No hands touching or holding the band. One photorealistic pose only. Same portrait dimensions about 1122 x 1402 pixels. NO text, numbers, arrows, overlays, collage, logos or watermark.

assets.target_pose: 背屈组起点：长坐，右小腿低软垫承托，踝自然中立、足趾放松，带绕右前足，锚点在足前方

review.identity_and_clothes: 首稿人物面貌与3张参考匹配；最终局部继承同人物白色T恤、深灰裤及肤色，最终近景不含脸
review.background: 灰蓝背景/地面、柔和棚拍光及自然阴影
review.visible_action: 右足近镜、左腿远镜，长坐垫面；右踝自然中立，足趾放松，没有主动下压/内翻/外翻
review.proportions_and_joints: 右膝、小腿、踝、足连接连续，脚趾数目及长短自然；近足透视比例可解释
review.contact_and_equipment: 右小腿接触低浅灰软垫，右跟与踝越出软垫 distal 边；带环在右前足跖骨/球部区而非勒趾，双股扁带接前方灰色低锚座，锚座落地，非接人体
review.visibility: 完整右膝及小腿、右跟/踝/五趾、带路径及全锚座均可见；左远足趾缘局部出画不影响右足任务
review.text_and_overlays: 无文字、编号、箭头、拼图、水印

assets.target_pose: 背屈组终点：保持右小腿支持、前方锚点，右前足对抗前方牵拉向右小腿抬起

review.method: view_image 原尺寸逐图目视审查，并与s01比较
review.identity_and_clothes: 同白T、深灰裤、肤色及身体局部，不含脸
review.background: 灰蓝背景/地面、柔光及自然阴影与s01一致
review.visible_action: 右前足和五趾作为整个足体回向右小腿，踝背屈方向清晰；不是只动趾，也未变为跖屈或内外翻
review.proportions_and_joints: 小腿未平移，踝到足连接自然，没有额外脚/趾；前足旋转后的踝前皮肤褶皱可解释
review.contact_and_equipment: 右小腿仍在原低软垫支持点；前方灰低锚座原位置不变，弹力带继续环住右前足球部并接同锚点，未勒趾、未加手持牵引
review.visibility: 右膝、整小腿、整个右足五趾和完整带/锚点可见
review.text_and_overlays: 无文字、编号、箭头、拼图、水印

group_review.camera_and_scale: s01/s02使用同右侧前方略高斜侧局部镜头、同构图/相机尺度、同地面与垫面基准
group_review.stationary_support: 右膝/小腿位置及软垫形状和位置保持，左腿/足与躯干局部保持
group_review.stationary_anchor: 灰色低锚座形状及地面位置、带固定点保持；带随前足背屈出现自然路径变化
group_review.movement_difference: 只需表现的右踝足从自然中立到背屈改变；右前足靠近小腿，s01/s02的方向差异清楚
group_review.independent_group_boundary: 仅背屈组01↔02；不表示与s03～s08连续八步，各方向卸张力后独立设置
group_review.sequence_and_reuse: s01→s02→复用s01表示控制回程，不另生成相同返回位
group_review.other_116_reference_review: 曾查看已完成116-s03用于外观一致性对照；未用其图作为本组生成或编辑输入

limitations: 最终图为踝足局部近景，不含人物面部；身份一致性依据三张参考和已审查首稿的继承，不声称最终近景能独立确认人脸。
静态AI生成图片只能核对可见姿势与接触关系，不能证明实际肌力、张力、锚座质量/承载、品牌型号、临床许可、剂量或真实动态回程。
提示词中的15～20度是出图方向约束；未作标定角度测量，也不从图片推导临床关节角度。
右足为任务足，完整入画；远侧左足部分边缘出画，仅作长坐及左右参考。
原始及未选生成稿留在Codex默认generated_images目录；最终采用PNG原文件复制，未裁图、缩放、重画或改变像素内容。
